title: The Visual Ecology of Speyeria mormonia

title: Perceptual Range, Targeting Ability, and Visual Habitat Detection by Greater Fritillary Butterflies Speyeria cybele (Lepidoptera: Nymphalidae) and Speyeria atlantis
why: A field and eye study of the great spangled fritillary and the Atlantis fritillary that tests which sense lets a butterfly detect habitat at a distance; it may state an eye measurement or an acuity estimate for Speyeria, which the stored abstract start does not show.
